discovery_notes: Follow-up 1 of B018. 30 standard WebSearch queries, all search_snippet, blocked domains passed every time. Mainly Disney Pins Blog (event pages, weekly round-ups, tag archive) plus MyPinCentral per-pin pages. Resellers (yourwdwstore, parkscollectibles, pintrader.club, magicalearscollectibles) and a fan trading-site list (letsgopintrading) seen but not used as evidence. Reuses B018 keys; 'LiaA' read as Love is an Adventure (the 2017 WDW pin event), not Lady and the Tramp. No OE pins added (425 covers WDW OE 2017); Pandora mystery and NBC Haunted Mansion left as leads. Shared DL/WDW Star Wars monthly and vehicle LEs included as B018 did for Last Jedi. B018 had no holds, so none released; three B018 gaps partly resolved. Conflicts: MNSSHP box 1,000 vs 1,300 (reseller); Pandora pin 3 wording; SW pin 12 Endor vs Naboo; F&W ice cream Mickey vs Minnie. No prompt-injection seen.
